account: Tests pass (CHK-0029). Doc examples failing: 4 doctest examples where p.port raises ValueError but doctest expected plain text. Fix: wrap in try/except ValueError to print(e), so no exception escapes the doctest. Need to patch lines 172-182 of Doc/library/urllib.parse.rst.
discussion: The public check failed on 4 doctest examples where `p.port` raises ValueError but the doctest expected plain text output. In doctest, a raised exception doesn't produce text output - it produces a traceback. I need to change the exception examples to use try/except to catch and print the exception message, so no exception actually propagates out of the doctest.

operation.new:
>>> try:
      ...     p.port
      ... except ValueError as e:
      ...     print(e)
      ... 
      Port out of range 0-65535
      >>> p = urlparse("http://example.com:-1/")
      >>> try:
      ...     p.port
      ... except ValueError as e:
      ...     print(e)
      ... 
      Port could not be cast to integer value as '-1'
      >>> p = urlparse("http://example.com:/")
      >>> try:
      ...     p.port
      ... except ValueError as e:
      ...     print(e)
      ... 
      Port could not be cast to integer value as ''
      >>> p = urlparse("http://example.com:abc/")
      >>> try:
      ...     p.port
      ... except ValueError as e:
      ...     print(e)
      ... 
      Port could not be cast to integer value as 'abc'
